Summary:
The Bar Attendant Supervisor is responsible for ensuring excellent customer service in a professional and timely manner. They will oversee and train junior staff, maintain a clean work environment, and perform a range of food and beverage service tasks, including liquor service and handling. Additionally, the Supervisor will take on leadership responsibilities in the absence of the Venue Manager, upholding the brand's vision and ensuring compliance with regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Provide guidance and training to food and beverage staff members.
•	Oversee bar operations and staff in the absence of the Venue Manager.
•	Ensure all customers receive prompt, courteous, and efficient service.
•	Handle customer inquiries and complaints in a professional manner.
•	Act as a frontline brand ambassador, reflecting the vision and reputation of the brand.
•	Develop and ensure repeat business by exceeding customer expectations.
•	Maintain a clean and organised work area, including bar, dining areas, cellar, and bathrooms.
•	Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.
•	Take food and drink orders accurately and prepare and serve a variety of beverages.
•	Prepare garnishes and maintain bar and cellar supplies.
•	Assist in the cellar or bottle department, including receiving, delivering, and recording goods.
•	Undertake general waiting duties, including food and beverage service and cleaning tables.
•	Accurately process sales and reconcile cash and electronic payments at the end of each shift.
•	Demonstrate proven sales abilities through add-on sales.
•	Unload stock and assist with stock management and conduct stocktakes as required.
•	Ensure the responsible service of alcohol at all times.
•	Understand and abide by liquor licensing regulations.
•	Obey all rules and regulations relating to safety, security, fire precautions, and personal appearance.
•	Participate actively in staff training.
•	Assist with back-office administration tasks and perform other duties as assigned by the employer.

Skills and Qualifications:
•	At least 1-2 years previous experience in a food and beverage service role, preferably in a supervisory capacity.
•	Hospitality qualifications desirable but not essential.
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills.
•	Ability to work well under pressure and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.   
•	Knowledge of food and beverage preparation and service techniques, including liquor service.
•	Familiarity with workplace health and safety regulations.
•	Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) certification.
•	Approved Manager’s License.
•	Proven sales abilities and experience with point-of-sale systems.

Additional Information:
•	This position requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.
•	The successful candidate will be a team player with a positive attitude, a passion for providing exceptional customer service, and a commitment to upholding the brand's vision.

Salary Range:  $71,550-$79,499

Job Title: Data Center Labourer / Assistant (Entry-Level)
Company: Ericsson
Location: Perth, WA (Data Center Environment)
Job Type: Full-time / Part-time shifts available (May include nights, weekends, or overtime)
Must Have: Working at Height Certification, PPE (Jacket/Shoes/Helmet/Gloves) and Basic Laptop

About the Role
SK tes is seeking motivated and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Center Labourer / Assistant. In this essential entry-level role, you will work within a highly secure, temperature-controlled data center environment, providing critical hands-on logistics and infrastructure support to our technical teams.
No prior data center experience is required, as comprehensive on-the-job training will be provided. This is an exceptional opportunity to kickstart your career with a global telecommunications leader.

Key Responsibilities (What You Will Do)
•	Equipment Logistics: Assist with moving, lifting and organizing heavy infrastructure equipment, including servers, racks and cabling materials.
•	Technical Support: Support on-site technicians with basic tasks, including handing tools and materials as needed.
•	Inventory & Labeling: Accurately label and organize cables, racks and inventory items to maintain an orderly facility.
•	Material Handling: Lift, push and pull equipment safely throughout the facility.
•	Waste Management: Dispose of packaging materials and electronic waste (e-waste) according to environmental and company guidelines.
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to all safety, security, and operational procedures to ensure an accident-free work environment.

Qualifications & Requirements (What We Look For)
•	Experience: No prior technical or data center experience required; full training is provided.
•	Certifications: Must hold a valid, nationally recognized Working at Height Certification (or be willing to obtain one before starting).
•	PPE: (Jacket/Shoes/Helmet/Gloves)
•	Basic Laptop
•	Physical Fitness: Ability to perform physical tasks, including:
o	Lifting up to 50 lbs (approx. 23 kg) regularly.
o	Standing and walking for extended periods.
o	Bending, kneeling, and climbing ladders when required.
•	Teamwork: Ability to follow instructions carefully and work effectively as part of a team.
•	Safety Awareness: A basic understanding of workplace health and safety (WHS) practices.

Work Environment & Equipment
•	Based inside a structured, temperature-controlled, and highly secure data center.
•	May require working in confined spaces or on raised floors.
•	Equipped with and required to use standard Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when necessary.
•	Equipped with a company laptop for logging tasks and inventory tracking.

Residency by Dillons, Tin Can Bay is a boutique family run aged care facility located in the heart of Tin Can Bay. Our home provides residents with equal access to care in a supportive and friendly environment. We respect residents' traditional and cultural backgrounds and provide an environment of peace, security, and harmony, allowing them to live creatively and independently.

We are currently seeking a Full Time Registered Nurse to join our friendly team. 

This opportunity will allow you to demonstrate your clinical skills within an organisation that values collaborative team work in a family focused environment to provide the best care for our residents.

Key Responsibilities/ Duty Description:

Assess, coordinate and monitor the individual needs and the provision of appropriate care to meet individual requirements of all residents.

Provide timely nursing interventions to ensure that the optimum level of health status is achieved by all residents.

Make appropriate referral of particular aspects of needs to senior staff or seeks assistance with more complex assessments.

Contribute to the development of individual care plans in consultation with residents, relatives and other support staff.

Respect the rights of each resident to make informed choices about their health care requirements and residency.

Maintain appropriate clinical records in accordance with legislative requirements and the policies of the Facility.

Ensure that all practices and utilization of goods and equipment is consistent with safety requirements.

Work in accordance with the Code of Ethics for Nurses and regulations as required by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia.



Essential Requirements:

Current AHPRA Nursing registration

Ability to lead a team on shift

Demonstrated ability to operate independently and professionally

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Current NDIS Clearance

Evidence of right to work in Australia

Demonstrated genuine desire to provision of care to frail and aged people

Experience working in Geriatric Care and/or Residential Aged Care is desirable. 

Knowledge and understanding of AN-ACC will be highly regarded.

Ability to effectively communicate in written and oral English.



What we offer:

Sponsorship opportunities for eligible applicants

Ongoing training opportunities and support for you to grow in your role

Staff engagement programs

Regular social events, such as morning teas and BBQ lunches

A supportive team environment

Family orientated work culture within a boutique aged care facility

Competitive Salary $80,000 – $115,000 per year



We are looking forward to filling this position as soon as possible and can’t wait to meet you! Click on “apply” and submit a resume and cover letter addressing your previous experience relevant to the role.

Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Who We Are
SunPork Group is dedicated to delivering the finest quality fresh Australian pork to market. We are proud to be the
largest Australian farmer owned and operated producer of quality Australian pork products. Employing 1,500+
employees across 52 locations in Australia and NZ.

SunPork is committed to animal welfare and the responsible, ethical care of animals to ensure their comfort, health
and welfare. Together with our dedicated specialist veterinary health, nutrition, research and development teams, and
farm and production teams, the person in this position is committed to the care of our pigs and the production of high
quality, sustainable pork.

What We Offer

By joining us, you will become part of an ever-growing family–passionate about producing the best quality Aussie
pork for Aussie plates. At SunPork we provide:

Professional learning and development opportunities;
Competitive salary;
Enjoy staff discounts on a range of products;
Base salary range: $79,500-$80,500.00 + Superannuation

The Opportunity

Sunpork Consolidated Pty Ltd requires Agricultural Engineering Technologist (Feedmill) to directly support our
Queensland Feedmill operations. The position is full time and will be based out of our Feedmill in Warra, Queensland.
This position requires ongoing testing and implementation of Feedmill engineering and production technologies to
support smooth and efficient production at all times.

Responsibilities, tasks, and duties:
-Operate, monitor and maintain feed mill production equipment and automated systems to support safe, efficient and
reliable feed manufacturing.
-Analyse production processes, equipment performance and operational data to identify opportunities for continuous
improvement and increased efficiency.
-Troubleshoot mechanical, process and automation issues, carrying out running repairs and supporting preventative
maintenance activities to minimise downtime.
-Support the implementation, optimisation and ongoing development of feed mill technologies, automation systems
and engineering solutions.
-Monitor raw material inventory, stock control systems, weighbridge operations and production reporting to ensure
accuracy and operational effectiveness.
-Conduct quality checks, process testing and equipment calibration activities to ensure compliance with FeedSafe
GMP standards and company quality requirements.
-Maintain a strong focus on workplace health and safety, quality assurance and environmental compliance while
promoting best-practice standards across the Feed Mill.
-Collaborate with operations, maintenance and management teams to support production targets, solve technical
challenges and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and experience

-At least a Bachelor's Degree level qualification
-Minimum 12 months relevant work experience
- Preparedness to work flexible hours (including some weekends and public holidays)
-Have the ability to work under pressure to meet production and customer requirements
-Be committed to upholding the highest levels of animal welfare and bio-security standards
-Be willing to undertake any additional training required for the role
-A demonstrated professional, safe organised and disciplined approach to work
-Current drivers licence

Work Location: In person

SunPork is an equal opportunity employer.

## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for managing payroll processing activities, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time. You will work closely with the finance, human resources, project, and operational teams to ensure payroll processes comply with company policies, awards, employment conditions, and relevant legislation.

Key Responsibilities
•	Process end-to-end payroll activities for employees, including weekly and fortnightly payroll cycles.
•	Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, deductions, leave balances, and employment details.
•	Verify timesheets, overtime, allowances, leave applications, and payroll adjustments.
•	Ensure payroll calculations comply with relevant awards, enterprise agreements, employment contracts, and legislation.
•	Process new employee onboarding, payroll setup, and employee changes.
•	Manage employee queries relating to payroll, leave entitlements, deductions, and payments.
•	Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for management and finance teams.
•	Process superannuation payments, payroll tax, PAYG withholding, and other statutory obligations.
•	Maintain accurate records and assist with payroll audits and compliance reviews.
•	Liaise with HR, project managers, supervisors, and employees regarding payroll-related matters.
•	Assist with improving payroll processes and maintaining payroll system accuracy.
•	Ensure confidentiality and security of employee payroll information.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Payroll Officer or in a similar payroll/finance administration role.
•	Experience processing payroll in a medium to large organisation is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of payroll processes, employment conditions, and statutory requirements.
•	Experience with payroll software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
•	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial and employee data.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	Ability to manage confidential information professionally.
•	Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with employees and management teams.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $90,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work within a growing mining and industrial services organisation.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
